data.narrative: Built a working FastAPI URL shortener with PostgreSQL, link creation, listing, retrieval, and redirects. Verified URL validation, expiry handling, pagination, and API behavior with manual requests and 10 passing automated tests.

dimension_scores.observation: Compared redirect route options and selected a prefixed route.
dimension_scores.evidence: Chose /r/{code} to separate redirects from /health and /links.

dimension_scores.observation: Inspected routes, reproduced requests, and added a regression test.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified API responses using curl and ran pytest with 10 passing tests.

dimension_scores.observation: Recognized unsafe redirect schemes and verified URL validation.
dimension_scores.evidence: javascript:alert(1) was rejected with HTTP 422; added a regression test.

dimension_scores.observation: Handled expired links and invalid pagination, but authentication is still missing.
dimension_scores.evidence: Expired links return HTTP 410; pagination rejects invalid values with HTTP 422.

dimension_scores.observation: Explained the route decision and API behavior with concrete reasons.

strengths: Implemented and tested the main URL shortener API endpoints.
Used PostgreSQL and database migrations to manage link data.
Verified URL scheme validation and added a regression test.
growth_areas: Add authentication and authorization so users can access only their own links.
data.recommendation: In Module 4, implement authentication and authorization and test that users cannot access or modify another user's links.

public_evidence.student_action: Implemented link creation, listing, retrieval, and redirect endpoints.
public_evidence.technical_detail: FastAPI routes POST /links, GET /links, GET /links/{link_id}, and GET /r/{code}.
public_evidence.proof: Manual API checks confirmed successful creation and retrieval, HTTP 307 redirects, HTTP 404 for unknown codes, and HTTP 410 for expired links.
public_evidence.ability: API development and HTTP response handling.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates implementation of a working REST API with redirect behavior.

public_evidence.student_action: Added automated tests for API behavior and unsafe URL rejection.
public_evidence.ability: Automated API testing and input validation.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows that important API behavior is checked automatically.

Verified that javascript: URLs are rejected.
